articles.summary: Acquisition adds OLN324, a Phase 3 investigational bispecific antibody for retinal vascular diseases, including wet AMD and diabetic macular edema Accelerates Company’s ambition to preserve, restore and enhance vision Builds on Johnson Johnson’s long-standing presence as an innovator in vision Johnson Johnson (NYSE: JNJ) today announced it has entered into a definitive agreement to acquire Ollin Biosciences, Inc., (“Ollin”) a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company developing therapies for serious eye diseases, for $2.2 billion upfront, with the potential for additional regulatory and commercial milestone payments. Johnson Johnson will also enter into a separate development funding agreement with Blackstone Life Sciences (“Blackstone”) to support the Phase 3 clinical advancement of OLN324, contingent upon acquisition close.
